shift-targets.name: Shift Targets
shift-targets.description: Characters with Shift and their valid targets

free.cheapBase.text: Free Shift. Play <BASE> early, then shift <SHIFT> in for 0 ink.

free.midBase.text: Free Shift saves ink, but <BASE> takes longer to set up.

free.expensiveBase.text: Free Shift, but <BASE> is expensive and hard to set up first.

curve.bothInkable.text: Perfect curve. Both cards inkable as fallback.

curve.oneInkable.text: Perfect curve. One card inkable as fallback.

curve.neitherInkable.text: On curve, but neither card is inkable. Less flexible off-curve.

curve.gap2.text: Smooth curve. <BASE> flows into Shift in a couple of turns.

curve.gap0.text: Same cost. No ink savings from Shifting, but skips the drying phase.

curve.gap3.text: Wide 3-turn gap. Playable but slow to set up.

curve.poor.text: The cost gap makes it hard to set up <BASE> in time to Shift.

activationBonus.text: Same target. Also unlocks the free Shift condition.

templates.ramp-trigger: {RAMP} adds ink to your inkwell, triggering {TRIGGER}'s inkwell effect.
templates.ramp-ramp: Both accelerate your ink. Gets you ahead faster.
templates.ramp-cost: {RAMP} adds extra ink, {COST} discounts your plays.
templates.trigger-trigger: Both effects activate on inkwell events.
templates.cost-cost: Both reduce costs. Stacking discounts plays cards faster.
templates.trigger-cost: Both support an accelerated game plan.
